limitations: File-level synthetic obfuscation labels, not malicious/benign package labels.
Techniques share source IDs, but an ID can have different original contents. Originals are deduplicated by SHA-256, not filename; technique comparisons are not fully paired.
code-compact and original are separate negative controls, not obfuscated positives.
Parse failures are reported separately and excluded from classification denominators.
No package entrypoint/capability context, restoration-quality or Tier3 evaluation.
Previously inspected dataset: regression validation, not an unseen holdout.
